title: Ravelry Stash Entry Stash Weight Leaderboard
dataSources: Ravelry projects (`ravelry:project`), knitCompanion row counters (`knitcompanion:counter`), Shelly smart-plug machine runtime (`shelly:status`), and Ravelry stash entries (`ravelry:stash`).
app: Ravelry project and stash exports, knitCompanion row-counter logs, and Shelly plug telemetry for sewing-machine hours sent to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ravelry:stash stash_weight_g=*
| stats sum(stash_weight_g) as total_value, avg(stash_weight_g) as avg_value by yarn_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks yarn name values by total and average stash weight across Ravelry stash entry events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `stash_weight_g` values for each Ravelry stash entry event and review total and average stash weight by yarn name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total stash weight.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which yarn name shows the biggest stash weight numbers in your Ravelry stash entry data.
